description: Ask a panel of ID verified people for their honest view when there's no right answer to check: which of two replies, designs, headlines or model answers is better, whether a customer would accept a reply or decision, how well something meets a brief (1 to 5), or whether a design, video or generated image has a flaw. You get the spread of views, a contested flag when people genuinely split, and a sample of one line reasons. format signoff (coming soon; test keys now) asks one top rated verified person to approve or reject an action after a fresh Face ID or Touch ID check, with a written reason: use it before an action someone must be accountable for. Live keys use prepaid credit at $0.20 per answer (a panel of 5 is $1.00) or $1.00 per sign off; test keys are free and simulated.

a_clip_url.description: compare: version A as an https video (MP4) or recording, played through before answering. Needs a_seconds

a_image_url.description: compare: version A as an https image

app.description: Which of the developer's apps this is for. Default: PLURES_APP, then the default app

b_clip_url.description: compare: version B as an https video (MP4) or recording. Needs b_seconds

b_image_url.description: compare: version B as an https image

clip_kind.description: Whether a_clip_url and b_clip_url are video (default) or audio

context.description: What people judge, or the shared setup for a comparison

format.description: accept (default): yes, yes with changes, no. compare: A or B (send a and b). rate: 1 to 5. flaws: looks right or has a flaw. signoff: one Trusted person approves or rejects. custom: send options

image_url.description: An https image to judge, like a design or a generated image

question.description: The question, e.g. "Which reply would you rather receive?"

reasons.description: Whether people add a one line reason. Default sample (about one in four); sign offs always do

rubric.description: What good looks like, in the developer's words, e.g. "Warm and clear, never pushy"

verifiers.description: Panel size. Default 5. A sign off is always 1

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait before returning a task_id to check later. Default 45, up to 240

name: ask_judgment
title: Ask people for their judgment
